wins: Agent consistently reached final reward threshold of 70 within a single episode, showing ability to execute through the full workflow when given extended time.
Mentor guidance was effectively incorporated across 10 calls, indicating strong responsiveness to human correction.
fails: 0% success rate indicates critical task objectives were never satisfied despite high reward, suggesting reward shaping failure or misaligned task understanding.
Repeated inability to resolve final access control stage likely tied to misprioritized enumeration steps and missing credential harvesting.
key_outcomes.summary: Agent achieved good reward accumulation but repeatedly failed the end-goal; focus on targeting precise exploit paths and credential gathering to convert reward into success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent bypasses deep service enumeration, jumping directly to exploitation without harvesting credentials, causing access denial at final stage.
